offering_description.value: Pangaea transports dry bulk commodities for producers, traders and industrial buyers using owned and chartered vessels, including ice-class ships. It also handles and stores cargo at U.S. port terminals.

primary_services.value: dry bulk ocean freight; ice-class shipping; vessel chartering; stevedoring; terminal cargo handling and storage

customer_segment.value: B2B: Commodity producers and traders, industrial manufacturers and other dry bulk shippers

end_markets.value: mining and minerals; steelmaking; agriculture; construction materials; energy

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Ocean freight under single-voyage and multi-shipment contracts; rental or leasing: Use of vessels under time charters; service fees: Cargo loading, unloading, handling and storage at port terminals
revenue_model.category: project or contract; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Uses owned and chartered ships to move bulk cargo for commodity producers, traders and industrial buyers; service provider: Plans voyages and handles bulk cargo at ports for shippers and industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: International routes serving North America, Europe and Asia, including Arctic waters, with terminal services in the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Dry bulk shipping, ice-class transport, vessel chartering and port terminal services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Commercial teams negotiate freight contracts with commodity shippers and industrial customers; own locations: U.S. port terminal operations deliver cargo handling and storage directly to shippers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Ship safety, crew standards and pollution controls under IMO conventions and flag-state and port-state oversight

notes: The current terminal footprint and the extent of sales through shipbrokers are uncertain.
